journey.name: usdt bridge support
journey.description: Use an onboarded wallet with an outbound cross-network transfer and an Orchestra deposit in its history. Existing history or a provider fixture is sufficient; do not submit a payment or support request.

actions.action: Enable USDT in the introductory sheet or Settings, General, Payments before starting this flow.
Open USDT from Home, then open a cross-network transfer in Activity.

Tap Details (id "UsdtActivityDetails"), then verify the source transaction is displayed. For an Orchestra transfer, verify the bridge reference is also displayed. Verify Contact Support and Copy Details use the small 40-point buttons side by side on one row, with neither label clipped.
Tap Copy Details (id "UsdtCopyDetails"). Verify the clipboard contains the bridge, networks, a readable status alongside its technical value, and available transaction references.
Tap Contact Support (id "UsdtContactSupport"). Verify the report form opens with those details prefilled and remains unsent. Return without submitting.

Open USDT Receive, then Network. Verify Cross-Network Deposits (id "UsdtDepositHistory") is a full-width primary button pinned over the bottom of the network list. Scroll the list and verify the rows and artwork pass behind the button while it stays fixed. Scroll to the end and verify the last content can be brought above the button. Repeat with large text and verify the button label is not clipped. Open it, verify rows show the source network and provider status, then open a deposit.

For a deposit whose conversion order is funded, confirming, swapping, bridging or delivering without an error, verify Pending is shown. Refresh after completion and verify Confirmed. An active order with an explicit error, or an unknown status, must show Needs attention. In Details, verify a readable support message appears instead of raw codes such as standing_route_unavailable.

For a deposit eligible for a refund, open Details and enter an owned address on the source network. With large system text enabled, verify the address field grows so the text is not clipped. Open and cancel the refund confirmation without requesting a refund. Scroll to Hide Details and tap it. Verify the refund field and keyboard close and the summary is readable. Reopen Details and verify the entered address remains available.

For a refunded deposit, verify the detail shows Refunded, even when an earlier error code is retained. Verify the transaction is labeled Refund transaction in the detail. Verify no pending-refund notice remains after refreshing the completed refund.
For a refund in progress, verify "Refund in progress" is shown for the provider's pending acknowledgment. A refund requiring operator intervention must still show Needs attention.

Verify Contact Support and Copy Details use the same small side-by-side buttons in deposit details. Tap Copy Details (id "UsdtCopyDetails"). Verify the clipboard includes the deposit reference, source network and source transaction, plus the readable current status, its technical value, any provider error code and any destination or refund transaction. Each value must remain on its own labeled line; embedded control characters in an older provider record must appear escaped rather than create extra lines.
Tap Contact Support (id "UsdtContactSupport"). Verify the report form opens with the deposit details prefilled. Return without submitting or requesting a refund.

Copy details for known source networks and verify their readable names are used, including Tron, Polygon and BNB Smart Chain. For an unknown network fixture, verify the original network value is retained rather than omitted.

At the largest system text size, open Cross-Network Deposits and a deposit detail. Verify each header and the Cross-Network Deposits footer show their full text, wrapping as needed without covering Back or Menu. Return to the default text size and verify the usual compact layout.
